summary: Iteration 266: Rate Override History Audit Trail, AI 'Why this rate?' Explainer, and Release-to-AI feature fully tested. All 14 tests passed. Fixed bug where release endpoint wasn't clearing live_pms_rate from owner_rate_overrides.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/rates/grid/submit-to-pms correctly appends to rate_override_history collection with action='submit', previous_rate, new_rate, delta, delta_pct, by, created_at
GET /api/rates/grid/history/{property_id}/{date} returns history items sorted desc by created_at

POST /api/rates/grid/release/{property_id}/{date} deletes owner-override from rate_overrides AND clears pms_override+target_sell_rate+live_pms_rate from owner_rate_overrides AND adds 'release' action to history
After release: grid live_pms_rate correctly falls back to default_rate (90)
After release: booking/reserve uses base_price (not the released override)

GET /api/rates/grid/explain/{property_id}/{date} returns ai_rate, breakdown (anchor, occupancy_signal, pickup_signal, guardrails), context (occupancy_pct, in_house, total_rooms, pickup_24h, compset_avg, lead_time_days, day_of_week, owner_override, is_locked), and narrative (Turkish text from gpt-4o-mini)
Explain endpoint works with no compset data (compset_avg=null) - still returns valid response and narrative
All 3 new endpoints require admin/manager auth (401/403 without token)
seed_data_creation: Test overrides created for dates 2027-05-15 to 2027-05-19 for history/release/explain verification.
